title: Frigate
description: Frigate NVR cameras in Matter: live video and audio, detections as motion, snapshots and cloud clip recording, with no ffmpeg needed. Every camera is its own Matter device: pair each one with its own QR code (plugin page, globe icon, or Matterbridge Devices).

frigateHost.title: Frigate address
frigateHost.description: IP address or host name of Frigate, without http:// (empty: the plugin looks for it on the network at startup)

discovery.title: Find Frigate automatically
discovery.description: When no address is set: search this machine and the local network on ports 5000 and 8971

restreamUser.title: go2rtc RTSP user
restreamUser.description: Only when go2rtc's RTSP restream has a user (go2rtc: rtsp: username in the Frigate config)

mqttHost.title: MQTT broker (optional)
mqttHost.description: The broker Frigate publishes to. Empty: detections come from Frigate's own WebSocket

addNewCameras.title: Add new Frigate cameras
addNewCameras.description: Cameras found in Frigate that are not in the list below are added at startup, switched on

cameras.title: Cameras (filled from Frigate; up to 16 switched on)

title.title: Name in Matter
title.description: Empty: Frigate's name for the camera

stream.title: go2rtc stream
stream.description: Empty: chosen automatically (best H.264 up to 1080p). After the first start a list of this camera's streams appears here

rtspUrl.title: RTSP URL instead of go2rtc (optional)
rtspUrl.description: Only for a camera without a go2rtc restream: rtsp://user:password@camera-ip:554/path (H.264)

rotation.title: Rotation
rotation.description: Turns the picture in live view, clips and snapshots

liveAudio.title: Live view audio
liveAudio.description: Opus from go2rtc as is, or made from G.711. AAC-only streams need an Opus track in go2rtc (ffmpeg:<camera>#audio=opus)

clipAudio.title: Clip audio
clipAudio.description: AAC in recorded clips (the camera's AAC as is, or made from G.711 / Opus)

detections.title: Detections
detections.description: Frigate's detections are motion on the Matter camera and start a clip when recording is on

objects.title: Objects that count
objects.description: Empty: every object Frigate tracks for this camera (person, car, dog, ...)

motion.title: Frigate motion counts too
motion.description: Also Frigate's pixel motion (without an object); more clips, more false alarms

recording.title: Recording
recording.description: Clips of detections or the record button, with a few seconds from before, saved by the hub (SmartThings cloud). Keeps the stream connected

keepConnected.title: Keep the stream connected
keepConnected.description: Faster live view start when recording is off (recording always keeps it connected)

ptz.title: Pan, tilt and zoom (experimental)
ptz.description: For a PTZ camera Frigate controls over ONVIF (onvif: in the Frigate config): arrows, zoom and the camera's presets in the Matter app
